exchangeFormat: Atlantic Canada (NL/PE/NB/NS): RST + 5-letter province+county/division code (e.g. NSANP, NLASJ). Out-of-region VE/W: RST + province/state. Other: RST + 'DX'. Bands 80-10m. SSB/CW only (NO digital). Atlantic Canada works everyone; out-of-region works Atlantic Canada only.

scoringRules.scoreFormula: Σ QSO pts × Σ mults (counted ONCE PER BAND) + bonuses. 1 pt/QSO regardless of mode. In-region entrant mult = each Canadian province/territory (13) + each US state (50, DC→MD), per band; an in-region station's 5-letter province+county code contributes its leading-2-char PROVINCE token (including own province); DX = no mult. Out-of-region entrant mult = distinct Atlantic-Canada county/division codes per band (47: NS 18 / NB 15 / PE 3 / NL 11). Atlantic Canada works everyone; out-of-region scores Atlantic-Canada contacts only (non-region↔non-region no credit). Mobiles/portables county-line = separate QSO per division. Bonus stations (VE1RAC/VE9RAC/VY2RAC/VO1RAC/VO2RAC/VE0CNM/VE0MMA/VO1ACQ/VE9ACQ/VA1ACQ) = +5 once per band & mode. Claimed/running — the ACQP committee re-adjudicates. The 'and mode' nuance on the in-region provincial mult is treated as per-band (the stated 63/band cap); claimed.
